newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN CLUB BANNED AFTER FANS BEAT UP REFEREE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN CLUB BANNED AFTER FANS BEAT UP REFEREE.

text.p: An Italian local league soccer club has been banned from using its ground for seven months after fans hit linesmen and beat up the referee.

The Italian agency ANSA reported that a sports judge overseeing provincial soccer in the central region of Umbria had banned Bastardo after some 30 fans invaded the pitch in the second half of a match against Virtus-La Castellana.

"They repeatedly hit the linesmen and then made for the referee who was hit several times by slaps and punches all over the body that caused great pain and even dizziness," the written report said of the match played last Sunday.
Bastardo, near the central town of Perugia, was ruled to have lost the match and docked two points.
